Scan a beachmat Matrix for Missing Values

Source: R/RcppExports.R
check_na_beachmat_matrix_cpp.Rd

Scan a beachmat Matrix for Missing Values

Usage

check_na_beachmat_matrix_cpp(initialized_matrix, max_store = -1)

Arguments

initialized_matrix

A beachmat-compatible numeric matrix; unstored sparse entries are treated as 0.

max_store

numeric. Maximum number of positions kept in the result; a negative value (default) keeps all. count always reports the total.

Value

A list with count (total number of NA/NaN values), row and col (1-based integer vectors of the stored positions).
